sam-mil-ecuador-manta-fol.n: Forward Operating Location (FOL) Manta, Eloy Alfaro Air Base
sam-mil-ecuador-manta-fol.cp: aerodrome-level (NOAA ISD station on the airfield, about 0.001-0.017 degrees); marks the airfield, not a specific base compound
sam-mil-ecuador-manta-fol.ty: Forward operating location (counterdrug detection and monitoring flights)
sam-mil-ecuador-manta-fol.what: Air Force: FOL Manta was 'located at the Ecuadorian Air Force Base Eloy Alfaro', opened 1999 under a 10-year lease and was deactivated 18 Sept 2009 when the lease expired. Ecuador's 16 Nov 2025 referendum rejected lifting the constitutional ban on foreign military bases: 'No' won 60.82% of valid votes (CNE final results).

sam-mil-colombia-dca-2009.st: Agreement without legal effect since 17 Aug 2010 (Constitutional Court Auto 288/2010)

sam-mil-ecuador-baltra.n: Seymour Island (Baltra) air and seaplane base, Galápagos
sam-mil-ecuador-baltra.cp: aerodrome-level (NOAA ISD station on the airfield, about 0.001-0.017 degrees); marks the airfield, not a specific base compound
sam-mil-ecuador-baltra.ty: WWII U.S. Army Air Forces and U.S. Navy base (Panama Canal Pacific patrol arc)
sam-mil-ecuador-baltra.dt: 1942 (first plane landed 14 May 1942) – 1946-07-01 (base turned over; USAF Air Warning Station personnel withdrawn 1948)
sam-mil-ecuador-baltra.what: FRUS: the United States 'constructed and operated a military base at Seymour Island during the war'; Ecuador requested withdrawal and the base was turned over on 1 July 1946; USAF technicians stayed until June 1948. Navy: South Seymour (Baltra) Island selected; seaplane base for two patrol-bomber squadrons; first plane landed 14 May 1942.

sam-blast-rio-tercero-1995.what: Series of explosions at the Fabricaciones Militares plant beside the city. Not an accident: Tribunal Oral Federal No. 2 of Córdoba (Dec 2014) convicted four former Fabricaciones Militares officials of intentional havoc aggravated by death (estrago doloso agravado); the Federal Cassation Court (Sala II) upheld the convictions in Dec 2017. The court linked the blast to concealing illegal arms exports to Croatia and Ecuador.

sam-blast-riobamba-2002.n: Brigada Blindada No. 11 'Galápagos' ammunition depot explosion, Riobamba
sam-blast-riobamba-2002.what: Explosions in the arsenal of the army's armoured brigade inside the city. The Army Chief of Staff said 4 of the dead were inside the unit (3 soldiers, 1 civilian employee). State of emergency declared by President Noboa. The French ministry's ARIA accident record cites a hand grenade activated accidentally as the reported trigger.
